name: Alt Splash Screen
description: Changes the 'splash screen' as it's called, which is the very first screen you see when the game fires up, to a different one that is red and black with God Kefka. Useful for any folks and/or streamers who do not wish to have the playable characters spoiled by them being on the splash screen.

name: Alt Window Designs
description: Changes all 7 of the window background/wallpaper to 7 different ones. If you use this patch after already starting up a game, you can fix the bad-looking window colors by reseting them in the config menu by pressing A on 'Window'.

name: Side B GFX
description: Side B GFX is simply all of the first round alternate main character graphics patches found in the 'extras' folder combined into one. Great for a repeat player or New Game +! Eventually we plan to have a 'costume room' sort of deal ala T-Edition, but for now this will have to suffice.

name: Fft Chocobo
description: This patch changes the classic vanilla FF6 chocobo into the Final Fantasy Tactics variant. This includes it's overworld sprite, mode 7 sprites. (riding and dismounting)

name: Gemini Font
description: This patch changes the default FF6 GBA small font (dialog) to that of Gemini's custom VWF he made for his Final Fantasy IV Prettified project.

name: Suits Removed
description: This patch will remove the sprite-change function that a few of the armors labeled as 'Suits' have, such as the Yeti Suit for instance. Just in case they become annoying.
